atoms.text: Geodes are hollow rocks that are filled with crystals. These crystals are created slowly over time, taking thousands, even millions, of years to form. In order for a geode to be made, you need water, pressure and a hollowed out rock. Water deposits minerals in the rock, which, over a long time and with lots of pressure, create crystals. Some people even go geode hunting for fun! Geodes can be commonly found in parts of the UK, such as Derbyshire, Aberdeenshire, Norfolk and Suffolk.
